scripts.dev:stripe: command -v stripe >/dev/null || { echo 'Stripe CLI not found; skipping webhook forwarding'; exit 0; }; stripe listen --forward-to localhost:6767/api/v1/webhooks/stripe --events checkout.session.completed,checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded,checkout.session.async_payment_failed,checkout.session.expired,refund.created,refund.updated,refund.failed
scripts.lint: bun --filter storefront lint && bun --filter admin lint && bun --filter api lint && bun --filter @workspace/ui lint
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter storefront typecheck && bun --filter admin typecheck && bun --filter api typecheck && bun --filter @workspace/ui typecheck
scripts.test: bun --filter api test && bun --filter storefront test && bun --filter admin test
scripts.build: bun --filter storefront build && bun --filter admin build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
